description: Store a website account and generate its current time-based one-time password locally.

fields.label: Website URL
fields.description: The HTTP or HTTPS website associated with this authenticator account.

fields.label: Username
fields.description: The username associated with this authenticator account.

fields.label: TOTP Secret
fields.description: The Base32-encoded TOTP secret. It is stored as a secret and never returned by actions.

actions.name: generate_code
actions.description: Generate the current six-digit TOTP code for the configured website account.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for generating the current TOTP code.

expiresAt.description: The ISO 8601 timestamp when this code expires.

remainingSeconds.description: The number of whole or partial seconds until this code expires.

website.description: The website associated with the configured account.

username.description: The username associated with the configured account.

outputSchema.description: The current TOTP code and its validity window.
